name: chart
title: Chart
description: Charts drawn by hand: bars coloured in with a marker, felt lines, pencil-shaded areas, pies, radars, dials, sparklines, tally marks and calendar heat maps. Real text on a real DOM, a keyboard cursor, a tooltip on a slip of paper, a legend that switches series off, a table for screen readers, and a pencil pattern on every series so colour is never the only channel.

files.content:
import type { PaintKey } from '@/lib/ink/paint'
import type { Bucket } from '@/lib/ink/charts/chart-scale'

export const SLOT_KEYS = ['marker', 'ink-you', 'green', 'hi-deep', 'grape', 'red', 'pencil', 'orange-text'] as const satisfies readonly PaintKey[]
export type SlotKey = (typeof SLOT_KEYS)[number]
export const SLOT_COUNT = SLOT_KEYS.length

export const slotKey = (slot: number): SlotKey => SLOT_KEYS[((Math.trunc(slot) % SLOT_COUNT) + SLOT_COUNT) % SLOT_COUNT]

export const PATTERNS = ['solid', 'hatch', 'dots', 'cross', 'lines', 'scribble'] as const
export type Pattern = (typeof PATTERNS)[number]

export const MARKERS = ['circle', 'square', 'triangle', 'diamond', 'cross', 'plus'] as const
export type MarkerShape = (typeof MARKERS)[number] | 'none'

export const DASHES = ['solid', 'dashed', 'dotted', 'dashdot'] as const
export type Dash = (typeof DASHES)[number]

export const defaultPattern = (slot: number): Pattern => PATTERNS[((Math.trunc(slot) % PATTERNS.length) + PATTERNS.length) % PATTERNS.length]
export const defaultMarker = (slot: number): MarkerShape => MARKERS[((Math.trunc(slot) % MARKERS.length) + MARKERS.length) % MARKERS.length]
export const defaultDash = (slot: number): Dash => DASHES[((Math.trunc(slot) % DASHES.length) + DASHES.length) % DASHES.length]

export type NotePen = 'red' | 'blue' | 'ink' | 'green'

export interface ChartLabel {
  id: string
  text: string
  x: number
  y: number
  anchor: 'start' | 'middle' | 'end'
  valign: 'top' | 'middle' | 'bottom'
  role: 'x' | 'y' | 'cat' | 'value' | 'note' | 'center' | 'sub' | 'ref' | 'axis' | 'legend'
  tone?: 'ink' | 'muted' | 'red' | 'blue' | 'green'
  size?: number
  maxW?: number
  hidden?: boolean
}

export interface ChartTargets {
  n: number
  mode: 'x' | 'y' | 'point' | 'sector' | 'cell'
  pos?: number[]
  cx: number[]
  cy: number[]
  nav: 'linear' | 'grid'
  cols?: number
  sector?: { cx: number; cy: number; r0: number[]; r1: number[]; a0: number[]; a1: number[] }
  cells?: { x0: number; y0: number; cw: number; ch: number; cols: number; rows: number; index: number[] }
}

export type CursorSpec =
  | { kind: 'column'; x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number }
  | { kind: 'guide'; x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number }
  | { kind: 'ring'; x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number; slot: number }
  | { kind: 'slice'; x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number; cx: number; cy: number; r0: number; r1: number; a0: number; a1: number }
  | { kind: 'cell'; x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number }
  | { kind: 'spoke'; x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number; x1: number; y1: number; x2: number; y2: number }

export interface ChartLayoutBase {
  w: number
  h: number
  bucket: Bucket
  labels: ChartLabel[]
  targets: ChartTargets
  cursorAt(i: number, series?: number | null): CursorSpec[]
}

export type XYKind = 'bar' | 'line' | 'area' | 'scatter'

export interface XYSeries {
  key: string
  name: string
  slot: number
  kind: XYKind
  pattern: Pattern
  marker: MarkerShape
  dash: Dash
  values: Array<number | null>
  xs?: number[]
  sizes?: number[]
}

export interface XYNote {
  s: number
  i: number
  text: string
  pen: NotePen
  shape: 'loop' | 'underline' | 'none'
  dx?: number
  dy?: number
}

export interface XYBand {
  i0: number
  i1: number
  text?: string
}

export interface XYRef {
  value: number
  axis: 'y' | 'x'
  label?: string
  pen: NotePen
}

export interface AxisTick {
  v: number
  label: string
}

export interface XYSpec {
  type: 'xy'
  cats: string[]
  series: XYSeries[]
  stacked: boolean
  horizontal: boolean
  curve: 'smooth' | 'linear' | 'step'
  yMin: number
  yMax: number
  yTicks: AxisTick[]
  yTicksAlt?: AxisTick[][]
  xMin?: number
  xMax?: number
  xTicks?: AxisTick[]
  xTicksAlt?: AxisTick[][]
  dots: 'auto' | boolean
  values: 'auto' | boolean
  valueLabels?: Array<Array<string | null>>
  grid: boolean
  showX: boolean
  showY: boolean
  zero: boolean
  notes: XYNote[]
  refs: XYRef[]
  bands: XYBand[]
  patterns: boolean
  state: 'ready' | 'empty' | 'loading'
  stateText?: string
  total?: number
}

export interface Slice {
  key: string
  name: string
  slot: number
  pattern: Pattern
  value: number
  label?: string
}

export interface PieSpec {
  type: 'pie'
  slices: Slice[]
  inner: number
  start: number
  labels: boolean
  patterns: boolean
  state: 'ready' | 'empty' | 'loading'
  stateText?: string
}

export interface RadarSeries {
  key: string
  name: string
  slot: number
  pattern: Pattern
  marker: MarkerShape
  values: Array<number | null>
}

export interface RadarSpec {
  type: 'radar'
  axes: string[]
  series: RadarSeries[]
  max: number
  levels: number
  ringLabels: string[]
  fill: boolean
  patterns: boolean
  dots: boolean
  state: 'ready' | 'empty' | 'loading'
  stateText?: string
}

export interface RadialRing {
  key: string
  name: string
  slot: number
  pattern: Pattern
  value: number
  max: number
  label?: string
}

export interface RadialSpec {
  type: 'radial'
  rings: RadialRing[]
  start: number
  end: number
  patterns: boolean
  state: 'ready' | 'empty' | 'loading'
  stateText?: string
}

export interface GaugeZone {
  to: number
  slot: number
  pattern: Pattern
}

export interface GaugeSpec {
  type: 'gauge'
  value: number
  min: number
  max: number
  zones: GaugeZone[]
  sweep: number
  ticks: number
  minLabel: string
  maxLabel: string
  patterns: boolean
  state: 'ready' | 'empty' | 'loading'
  stateText?: string
}

export interface SparkSpec {
  type: 'spark'
  variant: 'line' | 'area' | 'bar'
  values: Array<number | null>
  min: number
  max: number
  slot: number
  ends: boolean
  extremes: boolean
  state: 'ready' | 'empty' | 'loading'
}

export interface TallyRow {
  key: string
  name: string
  slot: number
  count: number
}

export interface TallySpec {
  type: 'tally'
  rows: TallyRow[]
  unit: number
  totals: string[]
  state: 'ready' | 'empty' | 'loading'
  stateText?: string
}

export interface HeatSpec {
  type: 'heat'
  cols: number
  rows: number
  levels: number[]
  levelCount: number
  colLabels: Array<{ i: number; text: string }>
  rowLabels: Array<{ i: number; text: string }>
  slot: number
  variant: 'calendar' | 'grid'
  legend: { less: string; more: string } | null
  patterns: boolean
  state: 'ready' | 'empty' | 'loading'
  stateText?: string
}

export type MiniParams =
  | { kind: 'swatch'; slot: number; pattern: Pattern; marker?: MarkerShape; line?: boolean; dash?: Dash }
  | { kind: 'column' | 'guide' | 'cell'; slot?: number }
  | { kind: 'ring'; slot: number }
  | { kind: 'slice'; cx: number; cy: number; r0: number; r1: number; a0: number; a1: number }
  | { kind: 'spoke'; x1: number; y1: number; x2: number; y2: number }

a11y: Every chart is one tab stop with arrow-key navigation. The drawing is a `role="application"` with an accessible name, a role description ("bar chart") and a spoken summary; left and right move between data points (up and down between series, or between rows for sideways bars and grids), Home and End jump to the first and last, Escape closes the tooltip. The current point is announced through a polite live region.

Each chart ships its data as a visually hidden table (a caption, column and row headers) next to the drawing. Charts that are pictures (empty, loading, static sparklines) are `role="img"` with the same summary; a gauge is `role="meter"` with a value, a minimum, a maximum and a text.

Colour is never the only channel: every series has a pencil pattern (hatching, dots, cross-hatching, rules, scribble) on its marks, and lines have a marker shape and a dash pattern. The legend and the tooltip show the same swatch as the drawing. Legend entries are buttons with `aria-pressed`.

All chart text is DOM text in the hand fonts at 12 px or more (15 px script in the default density). Ink on paper is 14:1; muted tick labels 8.9:1. The pointer never has to be used: everything the tooltip shows is in the live region and the table.

Reduced motion removes the wipe-on, the pulse and the cursor slide. In Windows high contrast the drawing is replaced by the data table. Calm density draws hairlines, no fill offset and 12 px hand text for dense screens. The plot always runs left to right (a time axis does not mirror); the legend and the words on the tooltip follow the page direction.
